user_prompt: In adults, what is the effect of remote or web 2.0 physical activity interventions compared with placebo, no intervention, or minimal intervention on self-reported physical activity, measured at 12 months follow-up?  Extract only self-reported physical activity at the 12-month timepoint — exclude cardiorespiratory fitness, dichotomous outcomes (e.g., meeting activity guidelines), and any 24-month follow-up data. Extract raw arm-level mean, SD, and N for each group; different studies may use different physical activity measures/units, so pool as a standardized mean difference (SMD) rather than assuming a common unit. If multiple eligible assessments are reported, use the one closest to 12 months. Exclude protocols and non-RCTs.
